one_line: Dutch-born commander and chief artillery officer who helped modernise Travancore’s army and fortifications after the Battle of Colachel.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, tall and broad-shouldered, with a disciplined soldier’s posture and the sturdy build of a field commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with a prominent, straight nose, light olive European complexion tanned by the tropical sun, sharp grey-blue eyes, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing his mouth; default expression is calm, focused determination with a hint of sternness.
appearance.hair: Ash-brown hair, slightly wavy, cut just above the collar and combed back from the forehead; he wears a simple dark navy-blue tricorn hat with a narrow brim and a thin brass trim, usually kept straight and level on his head.
appearance.costume: Mid-18th century European officer adapted to Travancore service: a dark navy-blue knee-length military coat in thick wool, single-breasted with simple brass buttons and muted off-white facings, worn over a light cream linen waistcoat and a high-collared off-white linen shirt; a plain dark red sash is tied firmly around his waist, knot over the left hip, hinting at his Travancore rank; he wears buff-coloured knee-length breeches and dark brown leather knee-high riding boots with a slight heel; on his left shoulder sits a modest dark navy-blue shoulder strap (epaulette-like but not exaggerated), and over his chest a brown leather cross-belt supporting a cartridge box; he sometimes has a light brown cotton shawl or scarf looped loosely around his neck to suggest adaptation to local climate; no lace or frills, everything practical and slightly weathered, suitable for forts and field inspections.
appearance.signature: A polished steel officer’s smallsword with a simple brass hilt and knuckle-bow, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard on his left side; in hand, he often wields a rolled parchment map or fort-plan in his off-hand to emphasise his role in artillery and fortification design.

ref_desc: Eustachius De Lannoy is a tall, mid-40s European officer with ash-brown collar-length hair under a navy tricorn, tanned oval face with grey-blue eyes and trimmed beard, wearing a navy coat, cream waistcoat, red sash, buff breeches, brown boots, and carrying a brass-hilted smallsword plus a rolled map.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Eustachius De Lannoy: a tall, mid-40s European artillery officer in mid-18th century Travancore service, with an oval, tanned light-olive face, sharp grey-blue eyes, and a neatly trimmed moustache with short beard; his ash-brown, slightly wavy hair is cut just above the collar and combed back, topped by a dark navy-blue tricorn hat with narrow brim and thin brass trim. He wears a dark navy-blue knee-length wool officer’s coat with single-breasted brass buttons and muted off-white facings, over a light cream linen waistcoat and high-collared off-white linen shirt; a plain dark red sash is tied around his waist, knot over the left hip, suggesting his Travancore rank. Show buff-coloured knee-length breeches and dark brown leather knee-high riding boots, with a brown leather cross-belt across his chest holding a cartridge box, and a subtle navy shoulder strap on his left shoulder; optionally, a light brown cotton scarf or shawl rests loosely at his neck to show adaptation to the Indian climate. His signature weapon is a polished steel officer’s smallsword with a simple brass hilt and knuckle-bow in a plain brown leather scabbard on his left side, and in his other hand he holds a rolled parchment map or fortification plan; depict him front, side, and back in the same outfit, with consistent navy, dark red, cream, buff, and dark brown colours, calm determined expression, and disciplined military posture.
